supersedes.reason: v1 circularly required R06 before the only permitted join that can measure R06 ambiguity

purpose: A model-independent, one-time sealed audit that jointly measures R06 ambiguity, R07 runtime-join coverage, and the R13 common eligible action-space hash. It cannot create or reveal a performance outcome.

preconditions.required_pre_access_proof: The frozen formal-runtime membership hash above was recorded before candidate-level BLIND runtime-join inspection.

roles.blind_custodian: Runs the one allowed join inside the sealed BLIND environment and releases only the prescribed aggregate receipt.
roles.independent_auditor: Verifies contract and tool hashes, fixed circuit set, aggregate receipt schema, and R06/R07/R13 decision rules without receiving candidate-level records.
roles.model_or_tuning_operator: Must not receive BLIND records or use this audit for training, selection, calibration, tuning, or performance comparison.

one_shot_protocol.atomic_release: Release one final aggregate receipt only after all three circuits complete; do not release partial per-circuit results.
one_shot_protocol.failure_action: Immediately reseal all BLIND artifacts; publish no candidate-level or partial per-circuit result; record only one failed aggregate receipt; do not retry under this contract.

allowed_receipt.aggregation: one atomic receipt containing per blind circuit and method counts only; no candidate-level rows

R06.pass_when: For every audited BLIND circuit and method, ambiguous_runtime_join_count == 0.

R07.pass_when: For each of s9234, s38584, and wb_dma, every executed-stage action has exactly one runtime join: missing_runtime_join_count == 0, ambiguous_runtime_join_count == 0, and coverage_rate == 1.0.

R13.pass_when: R06 and R07 pass and, within each BLIND circuit, every audited method has the identical frozen runtime-eligible action-space hash, with no exclusion introduced after unseal.

decision_rules.p0: The receipt informs a later runtime-recovery assessment only. P0 remains BLOCKED until an independent assessment establishes every R01 through R14 as PASS.
